title: POST /api/cart/coupon returns 500 when code is padded with spaces
expected: Bad input for code is rejected with a 4xx and a helpful message
actual: POST /api/cart/coupon answered 500 (server error) for code = padded with spaces: " SAVE10 ". Also failed for: nothing else.

source.why: Validation uses trimmed input but lookup uses untrimmed, so getCoupon returns undefined and coupon.code throws
